answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops a sybil spiral: a new identity locks 40 POA for 20 epochs, names a sponsor, and any peer may dispute it — a proven fake burns the deposit and slashes the sponsor too. Honest identities bend like a willow under such checks and get the deposit back in full. Forged identities freeze: 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 POA in a tundra of dead capital, while one honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps its full share.
